_about: Inventory of code in this PUBLIC repo that can write to a public GitHub repo. tests/public-writer-inventory.test.mjs scans the repo for writers and fails if one is neither gated by setup/public-write-gate.mjs nor listed below with a reason. Anything that records findings, notes or diagnostics must use the gate. Finance, legal, investor, deal, inside information, privileged, PHI and personal findings never go to a public repo; record them in the private ledger (memory_remember with type finding, or task_create). A new exemption needs a reason of at least 20 characters and a reviewer who agrees the code writes no findings or lane-tagged records.

exempt.reason: Timed agent runner. It pushes a claude/* branch of code changes and opens a DRAFT pull request that a person reviews. It writes code, not findings, and the agent holds only a repo-scoped token with no finance or legal data source. Follow-up: gate the task input.

Posts a review comment on the pull request it runs for. The text is derived from that pull request's own diff, not from lane-tagged findings.
Posts the prompt regression scorecard as a comment on the pull request it runs for. The content is eval scores for that pull request's own prompt files.

Generic GitHub transport (request, ready-pr, merge-pr, graphql). It has no notion of a finding or a lane, so it cannot be gated here. Callers that record findings must use a gated writer; the gateway level gap is tracked separately.
